name: London Project affiliate layout standard v6 - five category Coupang mix
selection_principles: This v6 policy supersedes every older affiliate category-mix instruction in the repository.
Each article has exactly three branded header buttons in this order: Coupang Partners, OLIVE YOUNG, Trip.com.
All ten bottom product cards are genuine Coupang Partners products only.
Every article contains exactly 2 beauty/cosmetics, 1 laptop, 1 desktop PC, 2 health supplements, 2 Korea travel packages, and 2 Korea hotel products.

Each site's product pool is site-specific and targets approximately 100 verified Coupang offers: 20 beauty, 10 laptops, 10 desktop PCs, 20 health supplements, 20 Korea travel packages, 20 hotel products.
Rotate product selections so the ten-item set generally changes every 10 to 20 posts; do not force every single article to have a completely unique set.
Use article topic relevance for selection within the five required categories without changing the category counts.
Use only genuine account-generated Coupang tracking links and official product images captured from Coupang Partners. Never invent links, products, images, prices, sales, reviews or commissions.
Olive Young and Trip.com are branded header buttons only, not bottom product-card providers.
Preserve editorial body, status, publication date, featured image and SEO metadata; replace only the designated affiliate block.
Apply this policy to both existing published articles (backfill) and every newly created article before it is published.
